messages:
alex_cheng: spinning up new org for acme-ai across AWS + GCP. need a concise quota/ops checklist so we can stand up dedicated dev & staging clusters. starting this thread to capture required requests and owners.

maria_gonzalez: +1. immediate asks: GPU quotas (a100, a10g, p4d), vCPU limits, persistent disk, network egress, and ENI limits. also need IAM roles and billing export. do we have a template? :thinking_face:

jordan_lee: short checklist to copy: 
- Org accounts: create AWS Org + GCP Org, link billing accounts
- Projects: acme-dev, acme-staging, acme-prod (use consistent naming)
- Enable APIs: IAM, Compute, VPC, ServiceUsage (GCP); EC2, IAM, Organizations (AWS)
- IAM: infra-admin, billing-reader, deployer (least-privilege svc accounts)
- Tagging: team, cost-center, env, project, owner
- Quotas to request: GPUs (region SKU specific), CPUs, persistent disk GB, routes, ephemeral ports, NAT gateways
- Networking: decide shared VPC vs project VPC, Cloud NAT / NAT GW plan, subnet secondary ranges for pods if using GKE/EKS
- Support: attach Business/Enterprise support ticket to expedite quota increases
- Cost: attach rough monthly estimate and finance approver

samir_k: here's a copy/paste template for support requests — use and edit per cloud/region:
```text
Subject: Urgent quota increase for new org onboarding — ACME
Environment: dev/staging/prod
Requested resources (example):
- AWS us-east-1: 40 p4d.24xlarge equivalents (or 400 A100 equiv GPUs), 2000 vCPUs, 500 ENIs
- GCP us-central1: 300 A100 GPUs, 5000 vCPUs, 200 TB persistent disk
Business justification: Redwood Inference will run evaluation + dev clusters for customer POC and internal CI. Need capacity for 4-week load testing and initial rollout. Estimated monthly spend: $<placeholder>. Finance contact: finance@redwood.com
Please expedite where possible. Thanks — Samir
```

maria_gonzalez: note: for GCP include specific GPU SKUs (e.g., nvidia-tesla-a100) and request regional quotas per zone if needed. if planning LB, also request forwarding rule and target pool quotas.

alex_cheng: tagging enforcement draft below — we'll enforce via policies after onboarding:
- team
- project
- environment
- owner
- billing-code
I'll add a policy PR to infra repo and a small script to block untagged resources.

ops_bot: Reminder: quota requests should include exact SKU names, region, and a clear business justification. Template: https://go/redwood-ops/quota-template :memo:

jordan_lee: extra infra notes: pre-create service accounts with least-priv roles, grant the billing service account Organization Billing Admin, and enable billing export to BigQuery (GCP) / S3 (AWS). set up cost allocation tags and enforce via SCPs/Org policies.

maria_gonzalez: I'll open the AWS support ticket and GCP quota case after I get final numbers from team. will attach the sample text and cost estimate. tagging + IAM draft incoming shortly. :thumbsup:

alex_cheng: one more — fallback/cost-sensitivity plan in runbook: if GPUs are constrained, use quantized models + smaller instance families, or burst to other region/fallback model variants. we'll add automated routing policies for that.

samir_k: quick CLI hints to gather current quotas before filing: 
```bash
aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A || true
gcloud compute project-info describe --project=acme-dev || true
```

maria_gonzalez: tasking: @jordan_lee: IAM policy draft; @alex_cheng: tags + runbook fallback; @samir_k: ticket bodies; @finance: please sanity-check the cost estimate when I DM it. I'll file tickets by EOD and update this thread with case numbers.

alex_cheng: perfect — thanks everyone. keeping this thread as the single source for the onboarding tickets and runbook updates. :rocket:
